metadata.title: Pembrolizumab 200 mg with axitinib
metadata.indication: First-line advanced renal cell carcinoma with a clear-cell component, with or without sarcomatoid features, meeting current NCCP prior-treatment criteria.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.

contexts.duration_text: Until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity; no trial cycle cap is inserted into the NCCP prescription

metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Source reconciliation draft; independent clinical approval pending
encoding_maturity.scope_note: Immune and axitinib toxicity pathways remain component-specific; uncertain attribution requires review. Combined liver rules use actual laboratory/ULN calculations and preserve the printed >3 versus ≥3 distinction. Pembrolizumab is held or stopped, never dose-reduced. Axitinib changes require the current dose and source-specific recovery. BP exact 160/105 and 12-week recovery boundaries are explicit review points; controlled endocrine toxicity has a separate continuation exception.

source_boundary_notes: Immune and axitinib toxicity pathways remain component-specific; uncertain attribution requires review.
Combined liver rules use actual laboratory/ULN calculations and preserve the printed >3 versus ≥3 distinction.

BP exact 160/105 and 12-week recovery boundaries are explicit review points; controlled endocrine toxicity has a separate continuation exception.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or the specialist authority specified in the current NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Use the most restrictive applicable component rule and confirm all dose changes against the current official NCCP PDF.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00583 Version 3b. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.

indications.description: First-line advanced renal cell carcinoma with a clear-cell component, with or without sarcomatoid features, meeting current NCCP prior-treatment criteria.

treatment.schedule_summary: Pembrolizumab 200 mg IV every 21 days with axitinib 5 mg orally twice daily, continuously, approximately 12 hours apart, with or without food. Continue according to response, tolerability and the consultant plan.
treatment.duration_text: Until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity; no trial cycle cap is inserted into the NCCP prescription

administration.note: Over 30 minutes every 21 days. Never dose-reduce.
About 12 hours apart, with or without food; dose changes require source-specific review. Do not replace a missed/vomited dose.

options.description: Fully active.
Restricted strenuous activity but ambulatory.
Ambulatory and capable of self-care; up more than half of waking hours.
Limited self-care; bed/chair more than half of waking hours.
Completely disabled; confined to bed/chair.

rules.explanation: Permanently discontinue pembrolizumab for the source permanent-stop criteria: other grade 4 or recurrent grade 3 immune events, grade 3–4 myocarditis/encephalitis/Guillain-Barré syndrome, or grade 3–4 infusion reaction. Separately assessed controlled endocrine exceptions are not included in this field.

action.message: If toxicity has not resolved to grade 0–1 or steroid dose cannot fall to ≤10 mg prednisolone-equivalent daily within 12 weeks after the last pembrolizumab, permanently discontinue. Review specific endocrine exceptions and the exact date.

rules.explanation: If toxicity has not resolved to grade 0–1 or steroid dose cannot fall to ≤10 mg prednisolone-equivalent daily within 12 weeks after the last pembrolizumab, permanently discontinue. Review specific endocrine exceptions and the exact date.

action.message: At the 12-week boundary, confirm exact treatment date, recovery and steroid dose against the source stopping rule; do not automatically restart.

rules.explanation: At the 12-week boundary, confirm exact treatment date, recovery and steroid dose against the source stopping rule; do not automatically restart.

action.message: Axitinib: SBP >160 or DBP >105, hold until BP <150/100 and adjust antihypertensives, then restart one dose level lower. Monitor for hypotension after interruption.

rules.explanation: Axitinib: SBP >160 or DBP >105, hold until BP <150/100 and adjust antihypertensives, then restart one dose level lower. Monitor for hypotension after interruption.

action.message: The printed BP bands omit SBP exactly 160 and DBP exactly 105. Obtain clinical review; do not treat equality as automatic permission to continue.

rules.explanation: The printed BP bands omit SBP exactly 160 and DBP exactly 105. Obtain clinical review; do not treat equality as automatic permission to continue.

action.message: Intermediate BP elevation: institute or increase antihypertensive treatment; if already maximal, reduce axitinib one dose level. Apply the more restrictive finding when systolic and diastolic values differ.

rules.explanation: Intermediate BP elevation: institute or increase antihypertensive treatment; if already maximal, reduce axitinib one dose level. Apply the more restrictive finding when systolic and diastolic values differ.

action.message: Permanently discontinue axitinib for hypertensive crisis/related neurological deficit or severe persistent hypertension despite treatment and dose reduction.

rules.explanation: Permanently discontinue axitinib for hypertensive crisis/related neurological deficit or severe persistent hypertension despite treatment and dose reduction.

action.message: Urine protein ≥3 g/24 h or source-convention UPC ≥3: hold until protein <3 g/24 h, then one level lower. Confirm units; do not compare a laboratory mg/mmol result directly with the source ratio.

rules.explanation: Urine protein ≥3 g/24 h or source-convention UPC ≥3: hold until protein <3 g/24 h, then one level lower. Confirm units; do not compare a laboratory mg/mmol result directly with the source ratio.

action.message: Proteinuria cannot fall below 3 g/24 h despite axitinib 2 mg twice daily: permanently discontinue.

rules.explanation: Proteinuria cannot fall below 3 g/24 h despite axitinib 2 mg twice daily: permanently discontinue.

action.message: Axitinib toxicity and immune toxicity can overlap. Determine attribution and review both medicines; do not use the more permissive axitinib diarrhoea row for possible immune colitis.

rules.explanation: Axitinib toxicity and immune toxicity can overlap. Determine attribution and review both medicines; do not use the more permissive axitinib diarrhoea row for possible immune colitis.

action.message: Grade 3 diarrhoea attributed to axitinib: source allows continuation one dose level lower. First exclude immune colitis/infection, assess hydration and confirm the current dose.

rules.explanation: Grade 3 diarrhoea attributed to axitinib: source allows continuation one dose level lower. First exclude immune colitis/infection, assess hydration and confirm the current dose.

action.message: Grade 4 axitinib diarrhoea follows the severe non-haematological pathway: hold and urgently assess; life-threatening toxicity has a permanent-stop rule.

rules.explanation: Grade 4 axitinib diarrhoea follows the severe non-haematological pathway: hold and urgently assess; life-threatening toxicity has a permanent-stop rule.

action.message: Even grade 1 haemoptysis requires interrupting axitinib and investigating the cause.

rules.explanation: Even grade 1 haemoptysis requires interrupting axitinib and investigating the cause.

action.message: Grade 2 bleeding: interrupt axitinib until grade ≤1 then one level lower, except pulmonary or non-haemorrhoidal gastrointestinal bleeding, which requires permanent discontinuation.

rules.explanation: Grade 2 bleeding: interrupt axitinib until grade ≤1 then one level lower, except pulmonary or non-haemorrhoidal gastrointestinal bleeding, which requires permanent discontinuation.

action.message: Grade 3–4 bleeding, or grade 2 pulmonary/non-haemorrhoidal gastrointestinal bleeding: permanently discontinue axitinib.

rules.explanation: Grade 3–4 bleeding, or grade 2 pulmonary/non-haemorrhoidal gastrointestinal bleeding: permanently discontinue axitinib.

action.message: Grade 3–4 axitinib renal failure/nephritis: hold until grade <2, then restart one dose level lower after review.

rules.explanation: Grade 3–4 axitinib renal failure/nephritis: hold until grade <2, then restart one dose level lower after review.

action.message: For other grade 3 axitinib toxicity, continuation at the same dose may be considered if controlled with symptom medicines or asymptomatic non-LFT biochemistry; otherwise one-level reduction may be used. Confirm attribution and clinical significance.

rules.explanation: For other grade 3 axitinib toxicity, continuation at the same dose may be considered if controlled with symptom medicines or asymptomatic non-LFT biochemistry; otherwise one-level reduction may be used. Confirm attribution and clinical significance.

action.message: Other grade 4 axitinib toxicity: hold until grade <2 then one level lower. The source exception for asymptomatic non-LFT laboratory findings requires explicit specialist assessment; no automatic continuation.

rules.explanation: Other grade 4 axitinib toxicity: hold until grade <2 then one level lower. The source exception for asymptomatic non-LFT laboratory findings requires explicit specialist assessment; no automatic continuation.

action.message: Permanently discontinue axitinib for life-threatening or recurrent severe/grade 3 drug-related toxicity, PRES/RPLS or arterial thrombosis/ischaemia.

rules.explanation: Permanently discontinue axitinib for life-threatening or recurrent severe/grade 3 drug-related toxicity, PRES/RPLS or arterial thrombosis/ischaemia.

action.message: ALT/AST ≥3 but <10 ×ULN with bilirubin <2 ×ULN: withhold both medicines until grade 0–1. Consider corticosteroids; any single-agent/sequential rechallenge requires specialist review.

rules.explanation: ALT/AST ≥3 but <10 ×ULN with bilirubin <2 ×ULN: withhold both medicines until grade 0–1. Consider corticosteroids; any single-agent/sequential rechallenge requires specialist review.

action.message: ALT/AST ≥10 ×ULN, or >3 ×ULN with bilirubin ≥2 ×ULN: permanently discontinue pembrolizumab and axitinib; consider corticosteroid treatment.

rules.explanation: ALT/AST ≥10 ×ULN, or >3 ×ULN with bilirubin ≥2 ×ULN: permanently discontinue pembrolizumab and axitinib; consider corticosteroid treatment.

action.message: The source does not allocate ALT/AST exactly 3 ×ULN with bilirubin ≥2: its stop row uses >3. Hold both and obtain urgent specialist clarification; do not silently convert this to a permanent-stop threshold.

action.message: ALT/AST ≥3 requires bilirubin to distinguish the combined hold and permanent-stop rows. Hold pending the missing result and clinical review.

action.message: Elevated bilirubin without the source combined enzyme criteria needs clinical assessment; the combination table does not provide an automatic dose decision for this pattern.

action.message: Avoid strong CYP3A4/5 inhibitors/inducers where possible. If unavoidable, reconcile an individual axitinib adjustment with pharmacy (the inhibitor example is approximately half, 5→2 mg twice daily); pembrolizumab is never dose-reduced by this rule.

eligibility: First-line advanced renal cell carcinoma with a clear-cell component, with or without sarcomatoid features, meeting current NCCP prior-treatment criteria.
Verify the current source eligibility and exclusions, treatment intent, prior treatment, blood counts and organ function.
exclusions: Known hypersensitivity to a regimen component
Pregnancy or breastfeeding where prohibited by the current source
Regimen-specific exclusions encoded in the assessment

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Highest emetogenic active component and phase-specific NCCP classification.
premedication: Confirm infusion appointments, daily tablet dose, home blood-pressure instructions and urgent contact numbers.
other_support: Routine anti-sickness prophylaxis is not usually required; use the individual symptom plan. Bring an immunotherapy alert card. Follow blood-pressure treatment, skin/foot care and the diarrhoea plan. Steroids for suspected immune toxicity require medical direction. Review CYP3A-interacting medicines, grapefruit and herbal products with pharmacy.
